UpgradeCode.title: Upgrade Code
UpgradeCode.description: Secure promo or upgrade redemption code for in-game features and rewards

code_string.description: The exact promo code string entered by the user

is_used.description: Whether the code has already been redeemed

used_by.description: Username or player ID who redeemed the code

used_at.description: Server timestamp of when the code was used

upgrade_type.description: The feature or reward unlocked by this code

reward_value.description: Numerical reward amount such as liras, jewels, or seconds

/upgrades_codes/{codeId}.description: Collection of promo and upgrade codes
